chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The adjustment of the brakes, clutch (or equivalent), engine and gear box shall be set in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendations for the purposes of use off the normal roads.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The tyres shall be those recommended for off-roads use.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: They shall have a tread depth of not less than 90 % of the tread depth of a new tyre.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The tyre pressure shall be adjusted to the value recommended by the tyre manufacturer.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The vehicle shall be loaded at its technically permissible maximum laden mass with a load distribution proportional to the distribution of the maximum mass on the axles as stated by the manufacturer.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: For example a vehicle of 7,5 tonnes with a maximum mass on the front axle of 4 tonnes and a maximum mass on the rear axle of 6 tonnes shall be tested with a mass of 3 tonnes (40 %) on the front axle and 4,5 tonnes (60 %) on the rear axle.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The surface of the test track shall be dry, made of asphalt or concrete

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The gradient shall show a continuous percentage of 25 % with a tolerance of + 3 % (θ = 14 degrees).

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The test shall be conducted with maximum masses reduced in relation to the test conditions.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: These conditions shall be reported.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The surface of the track shall show a good coefficient of adhesion.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The Skid Resistance Index (‘SRI’) of the surface shall be measured in accordance with Standard CEN/TS 13036-2:

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The mean value of the SRI shall be reported.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The vehicle shall be first placed on a horizontal surface.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The mode of traction shall be set as for off-roads use.

chapeau: At the request of the manufacturer the test shall be conducted on one of the following:
clause: The gear(s) engaged shall allow a steady speed.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: During free transient low-frequency vertical oscillation of the sprung mass above a driving axle or group of axles, the measured frequency and damping with the suspension carrying its maximum load shall fall within the limits defined in points 2.3. to 2.6.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: Each axle shall be fitted with hydraulic dampers.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: On groups of axles, the dampers shall be positioned to minimise the oscillation of the groups of axles.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: The mean damping ratio Dm shall be more than 20 % of critical damping for the suspension in its normal condition with hydraulic dampers in place and operating.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: The damping ratio Dr of the suspension with all hydraulic dampers removed or incapacitated shall be not more than 50 % of Dm.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: The frequency of the sprung mass above the driving axle or group of axles in a free transient vertical oscillation shall not be higher than 2,0 Hz.

chapeau: In order to be recognised as equivalent to air suspension, a suspension shall comply with the following requirements:
clause: The test procedures for measuring the frequency and damping shall be laid down in point 3.
